preconditions.description: The value of k is within the range from 0 to 104.
The value of m is within the range from 1 to 300,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m lines.
Each line in the output contains exactly 8 digits.
Each line in the output contains only digits.

postconditions.expression: all(line[0] != '0' or line == '00000000' for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output does not have a leading zero unless it is the string '00000000'.
All the lines in the output are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(is_k_lucky(int(line), k) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output represents a k-lucky ticket.
